logic.issue: Inner joins to olist_products_dataset and product_category_name_translation drop items whose product has a NULL category (610 products) and the 2 categories without an English translation.
logic.impact: Minor: those groups cannot appear in the ranking. Uncategorized revenue is not a category, and the untranslated categories are not expected to be large enough to reach the top 10, but this cannot be confirmed from the trace.
logic.fix: Optionally LEFT JOIN the translation and use COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) as the label.

unverifiable: Whether either of the 2 untranslated categories has revenue above the 10th row (garden_tools, 485256.46 BRL).

assumptions.assumption: Revenue = SUM(order_items.price), excluding freight, per the schema rule.
No order_status filter (all orders, including canceled), per the schema rule.

summary: SQL follows the schema rules (price-based revenue, English category names, no status filter, no fan-out) and returns a plausible top 10 led by health_beauty at about 1.26M BRL. The only caveat is that inner joins exclude untranslated or NULL categories.
